lessons.title: Qancha? much, many, a lot of
lessons.goal: Miqdor haqida gapirishni o'rganasiz: much / many / a lot of / a few / a little va meva nomlari.

frame.name: much / many / a lot of
frame.formula:
How many apples do you need?   — A few.
How much sugar do you want?    — A little.
There are a lot of grapes in the garden.
frame.explain: Miqdor so'zi otning sanaladigan yoki sanalmaydigan ekaniga bog'liq. apples — sanaladi (many apples), sugar — sanalmaydi (much sugar). a lot of ikkisi bilan ham ishlatiladi va tasdiq gaplarda eng ko'p uchraydi.
table: ikkisi bilan ham: a lot of fruit

aff: There are a lot of apples in the garden.
There is a lot of sugar in the tea.
short: Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.
Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.

examples.en: How many apples do you want? — A few, please.
examples.uz: Nechta olma olasiz? — Bir nechta, iltimos.

examples.en: There are a lot of grapes on the table, but there aren't many pears.
examples.uz: Stolda ko'p uzum bor, lekin nok ko'p emas.

examples.en: I need a little sugar and a few lemons for the tea.
examples.uz: Choy uchun bir oz shakar va bir nechta limon kerak.

examples.en: This watermelon is very sweet, and that melon is ripe too.
examples.uz: Bu tarvuz juda shirin, anavi qovun ham pishgan.

examples.en: Do we have any strawberries and raspberries in the fridge?
examples.uz: Muzlatgichda qulupnay va malina bormi?

examples.en: She doesn't like bananas, but she loves peaches and apricots.
examples.uz: U bananni yoqtirmaydi, lekin shaftoli va o'rikni yaxshi ko'radi.

examples.en: There is a lot of fruit in the market in summer: cherries, plums, oranges and mandarins.
examples.uz: Yozda bozorda ko'p meva bo'ladi: gilos, olxo'ri, apelsin va mandarin.

examples.en: How much juice can you make from one pineapple?
examples.uz: Bitta ananasdan qancha sharbat tayyorlash mumkin?

street.title: Meva bozorida

items.en: Give me a kilo of apples.
I'll take a bunch of grapes.

street.note: "How much are the cherries?" — narx so'rash; "How many...?" — sanash uchun: How many apples?

lines.en: How many watermelons do you need?
Just one, and a few peaches.
lines.uz: Faqat bitta va bir nechta shaftoli.

lines.en: How much are they?
Ten thousand for the watermelon, and the peaches are cheap.
lines.uz: Tarvuz o'n ming, shaftoli esa arzon.

lines.en: Are there any ripe melons today?
Yes, a lot of them. They are very sweet.

substitution.prompt: How ___ apples do you need? (much / many)
substitution.answer: How many apples do you need?

substitution.prompt: How ___ sugar do you want? (much / many)
substitution.answer: How much sugar do you want?

substitution.prompt: There are ___ grapes in the garden. (a lot of / much)
substitution.answer: There are a lot of grapes in the garden.

substitution.prompt: I need ___ lemons. (a few / a little)
substitution.answer: I need a few lemons.

substitution.prompt: There is ___ juice in the fridge. (a few / a little)
substitution.answer: There is a little juice in the fridge.

translate.en: I need a few apples.
There are a lot of grapes on the table.
There isn't much sugar in the tea.
This melon is very sweet.

fix.wrong: How much apples do you need?
fix.right: How many apples do you need?
There is a lot of fruit.
fix.why: fruit sanalmaydi → is + a lot of

lessons.tip: Ovqat va ichimlik nomlari ko'pincha sanalmaydi: fruit, sugar, water, bread, meat, rice. Ular bilan much / a little / a lot of ishlatiladi.

lessons.title: Taklif qilish: Would you like ...?
lessons.goal: Xushmuomala taklif va xohishni bildirishni o'rganasiz: would like, I'd like, Can I have ...?

frame.name: Would you like ...? / I'd like ...
frame.formula:
Would you like some tea?     — Yes, please. / No, thank you.
I'd like a cup of coffee.     (= I would like)
Can I have some water, please?
frame.explain: would like — "xohlayman"ning xushmuomala shakli. I'd like = I would like. Taklif qilganda Would you like ...? ishlatiladi, javob esa Yes, please yoki No, thank you. Bu struktura kafe, mehmonxona va ish suhbatida eng kerakli strukturadir.

aff: She'd like a cup of coffee.

examples.en: Would you like some tea or coffee?
examples.uz: Choy yoki qahva olasizmi?

examples.en: I'd like a glass of mineral water, please.
examples.uz: Bir stakan mineral suv olsam, iltimos.

examples.en: She doesn't drink coffee, but she loves tea with honey.
examples.uz: U qahva ichmaydi, lekin asalli choyni juda yaxshi ko'radi.

examples.en: There is some milk and cream in the fridge, but there isn't any yogurt.
examples.uz: Muzlatgichda sut va qaymoq bor, lekin yogurt yo'q.

examples.en: Would you like a piece of cake with your tea?
examples.uz: Choyingizga bir bo'lak tort olasizmi?

examples.en: Children drink juice and lemonade, and adults drink tea, coffee or wine.
examples.uz: Bolalar sharbat va limonad ichadi, kattalar choy, qahva yoki vino ichadi.

examples.en: I'm thirsty — can I have some water, please?
examples.uz: Chanqadim — bir oz suv olsam bo'ladimi?

examples.en: He'd like a bun with jam and a cup of coffee.
examples.uz: U murabboli bulochka va bir piyola qahva olmoqchi.

street.title: Kafeda
street.note: "I'll have ..." — buyurtma berishning eng tabiiy shakli; "I want ..." to'g'ri, lekin qo'polroq eshitiladi.

lines.en: What would you like to drink?
I'd like a cup of tea with honey, please.
Would you like some cake too?
No, thank you. Just tea.
And for your son?
He'd like some juice and an ice-cream.

substitution.prompt: Would you like ___ tea? (some / any)
substitution.answer: Would you like some tea?

substitution.prompt: I ___ like a glass of water. (would)
substitution.answer: I'd like a glass of water.

substitution.prompt: ___ you like some coffee? (would / do)
substitution.answer: Would you like some coffee?

substitution.answer: She doesn't drink coffee.

substitution.prompt: Can I ___ a cup of tea, please? (have / has)
substitution.answer: Can I have a cup of tea, please?

translate.en: Would you like some tea?
I'd like a glass of water.
She doesn't drink coffee.
Would you like some honey in your tea?

fix.wrong: Do you would like some tea?
fix.why: would o'zi yordamchi fe'l, do kerak emas

lessons.tip: Would you like? — taklif (hozir). Do you like? — umuman yoqtirish: Do you like coffee? (umuman qahvani yoqtirasizmi?) / Would you like a coffee? (hozir qahva olasizmi?).

lessons.title: Buyruq va taklif: Pass me the salt / Let's ...
lessons.goal: Buyruq maylini (imperative), inkor buyruqni va "let's" taklifini o'rganasiz. Oshxona idishlari lug'ati.

frame.name: Imperative + Let's
frame.formula:
Pass me the salt, please.
Don't put the knife there.
Let's have some tea.
Let's not wait.
frame.explain: Buyruq gapda ega yo'q, fe'l esa o'zak shaklda turadi: Open the door. Inkor: Don't + fe'l. Birgalikda biror ish qilishni taklif qilish uchun Let's + fe'l ishlatiladi. Xushmuomalalik uchun please qo'shiladi.

aff: Put the plate on the tray.
neg: Don't put the plate on the tray.
Let's not wash the dishes now.
q: Can you pass me the fork?

examples.en: Pass me the spoon, please.
examples.uz: Iltimos, qoshiqni bering.

examples.en: Don't put the hot pan on the table.
examples.uz: Issiq qozonni stolga qo'ymang.

examples.en: Let's have tea from these cups.
examples.uz: Keling, choyni shu chashkalarda ichamiz.

examples.en: Put the plates, forks and knives on the tray.
examples.uz: Likoplar, sanchqilar va pichoqlarni patnisga qo'ying.

examples.en: There is a bottle of water and a jar of honey on the table.
examples.uz: Stolda bir shisha suv va bir banka asal bor.

examples.en: Don't use this frying pan — it's dirty.
examples.uz: Bu tovani ishlatmang — iflos.

examples.en: Let's boil some water in the kettle and make tea in the teapot.
examples.uz: Keling, choynakda suv qaynatib, choydamda choy damlaymiz.

examples.en: Wash the dishes in the sink, please.
examples.uz: Iltimos, idishlarni rakovinada yuving.

street.title: Oshxonada

items.en: Can you give me a napkin?

street.note: "Here you are" — biror narsa uzatganda aytiladigan standart jumla; "Here it is" — narsani topib ko'rsatganda.

lines.en: Pass me the knife, please.
Here you are. Do you need a cutting board?
Yes, and a plate for the bread.
Don't use that plate, it's dirty.
OK. Let's wash the dishes after lunch.
lines.uz: Mayli. Keling, tushlikdan keyin idishlarni yuvamiz.

lines.en: Sure. And let's not forget the kettle.

substitution.prompt: ___ me the salt, please. (pass)
substitution.answer: Pass me the salt, please.

substitution.prompt: ___ put the hot pan on the table. (inkor)
substitution.answer: Don't put the hot pan on the table.

substitution.prompt: ___ have some tea. (let's)
substitution.answer: Let's have some tea.

substitution.prompt: There is a ___ of honey on the table. (banka)
substitution.answer: There is a jar of honey on the table.

substitution.prompt: Wash the dishes in the ___ . (rakovina)
substitution.answer: Wash the dishes in the sink.

translate.en: Pass me the spoon, please.
Don't use this frying pan.
Let's have some tea.
Let's not wash the dishes now.

fix.wrong: Don't to put the knife here.

fix.why: let's dan keyin fe'l o'zak shaklda

lessons.tip: Buyruq ohangi qattiq eshitilmasligi uchun uchta usul bor: please qo'shish, gapni savol shaklida aytish (Can you pass me the salt?), yoki Could you ...? bilan boshlash.

lessons.title: Qanday borasiz? by bus, on foot
lessons.goal: Transport predloglarini o'zlashtirasiz: by / on / in, "on foot" va "How do you get to ...?" savoli.

frame.name: Transport predloglari
frame.formula:
I go to work by bus.        by car / by train / by plane
I go on foot.                → piyoda
I'm in the car. / I'm on the bus.
How do you get to work?
frame.explain: Transport turi haqida gapirganda by ishlatiladi va artikl qo'yilmaydi: by bus, by train, by plane. Piyoda yurish — on foot. Konkret mashina yoki avtobusda o'tirganda esa in a car, on a bus deyiladi.
table: in a car / in a taxi
on the bus / on the train

aff: I go to work by bus.
She goes to school by tram.
neg: I don't go to work by bus.
She doesn't go to school by tram.
q: Do you go to work by bus?
How do you get to the airport?
short: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

examples.en: I go to work by bus, and my brother goes by bicycle.
examples.uz: Men ishga avtobusda boraman, akam velosipedda.

examples.en: How do you get to the airport — by taxi or by train?
examples.uz: Aeroportga qanday borasiz — taksi bilanmi yoki poyezdda?

examples.en: There is a lot of traffic in the city center, so I often go on foot.
examples.uz: Shahar markazida tirbandlik ko'p, shuning uchun ko'pincha piyoda boraman.

examples.en: The train leaves from platform two, and the ticket costs fifty thousand.
examples.uz: Poyezd ikkinchi platformadan jo'naydi, chipta ellik ming turadi.

examples.en: She doesn't like planes, so she travels by ship or by train.
examples.uz: U samolyotlarni yoqtirmaydi, shuning uchun kema yoki poyezdda yuradi.

examples.en: Is there a subway station near the hotel?
examples.uz: Mehmonxona yaqinida metro bekati bormi?

examples.en: Passengers must keep their luggage with them.
examples.uz: Yo'lovchilar yukini o'zlari bilan olib yurishlari kerak.

examples.en: We need some fuel for the car before the journey.
examples.uz: Safardan oldin mashinaga yonilg'i kerak.

street.title: Yo'lda

items.en: How do I get to the station?

street.note: "It's a ten-minute walk" — "o'n daqiqalik yo'l"; vaqt + ot birikmasi chiziqcha bilan yoziladi va ko'plikda -s olmaydi.

lines.en: How do you get to work every day?
By metro, then by bus. It's faster than a taxi.
Is there a lot of traffic in the morning?
Yes, very much. That's why I don't drive my car.
lines.uz: Ha, juda. Shuning uchun mashinamni haydamayman.

lines.en: Where do you buy tickets?
At the station, near the platform.

substitution.prompt: I go to work ___ bus. (by / on)
substitution.answer: I go to work by bus.

substitution.prompt: She goes to school ___ foot. (by / on)
substitution.answer: She goes to school on foot.

substitution.prompt: We are ___ the train. (in / on)
substitution.answer: We are on the train.

substitution.prompt: How do you ___ to the airport? (get)
substitution.answer: How do you get to the airport?

substitution.prompt: I travel ___ plane. (by / in)
substitution.answer: I travel by plane.

translate.en: I go to work by bus.
She goes to school on foot.
How do you get to the airport?
The train leaves from platform two.

fix.wrong: I go to work with bus.
fix.right: I go to work by bus.

fix.why: taksi bilan — by taxi (yoki in a taxi)

fix.wrong: How you get to the station?
fix.right: How do you get to the station?

lessons.tip: by dan keyin artikl yo'q: by bus, by car, by plane. Lekin in a car, on a bus — konkret mashina yoki avtobus haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi: I'm in a taxi.

lessons.title: Vaqt: at, on, in
lessons.goal: Vaqt predloglarini va vaqt haqidagi so'zlarni o'zlashtirasiz: at 7, on Monday, in July.

frame.name: Vaqt predloglari at / on / in
frame.formula:
at 8 o'clock     at night
on Monday        on 5 May
in the morning   in July   in 2026
What time is it? — It's half past seven.
frame.explain: Uch predlog uch xil vazifani bajaradi: at — aniq vaqt va tun; on — kun va sana; in — oy, yil, asr va kunning qismlari. Istisnolar: at night, in the morning / afternoon / evening.
table: at 7 o'clock, at night, at noon
on Monday, on 5 May, on my birthday
in the morning, in July, in 2026
in five minutes — besh daqiqadan keyin
What time do you get up?

aff: I get up at seven o'clock.
We go to the cinema on Fridays.
neg: I don't get up at seven o'clock.
We don't go to the cinema on Fridays.
q: Do you get up at seven o'clock?
What time does she start work?
short: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

examples.en: I usually get up at seven in the morning.
examples.uz: Men odatda ertalab yettida turaman.

examples.en: She works from Monday to Friday, and she rests on Saturday.
examples.uz: U dushanbadan jumagacha ishlaydi, shanba kuni dam oladi.

examples.en: We don't work at night, so we go home at six in the evening.
examples.uz: Biz tunda ishlamaymiz, shuning uchun kechqurun oltida uyga qaytamiz.

examples.en: The day before yesterday was Sunday, and the day after tomorrow is Tuesday.
examples.uz: Avvalgi kun yakshanba edi, indinga seshanba.

examples.en: My grandfather was born in the last century, in 1950.
examples.uz: Buam o'tgan asrda, 1950-yilda tug'ilgan.

examples.en: I'm late today — I need five more minutes.
examples.uz: Bugun kechikyapman — yana besh daqiqa kerak.

examples.en: What time is it now? — It's a quarter past eight.
examples.uz: Hozir soat necha? — Sakkizdan o'n besh daqiqa o'tdi.

examples.en: He never works on Sunday, but he sometimes works late on Friday.
examples.uz: U yakshanba kuni hech qachon ishlamaydi, lekin ba'zan juma kuni kechgacha ishlaydi.

street.title: Vaqt haqida
street.note: "I'm running late" — hozir kechikyapman; "I'm late" — umumiy holat. "Give me a minute" — "bir daqiqa kutib turing".

lines.en: What time do you start work?
At nine in the morning, and I finish at six.
Do you work on Saturday?
Sometimes, but usually not.
Are you free tomorrow evening?
Yes, I'm free after eight.

substitution.prompt: I get up ___ seven o'clock. (at / on / in)
substitution.answer: I get up at seven o'clock.

substitution.prompt: We meet ___ Friday. (at / on / in)
substitution.answer: We meet on Friday.

substitution.prompt: She rests ___ the afternoon. (at / on / in)
substitution.answer: She rests in the afternoon.

substitution.prompt: He was born ___ May. (at / on / in)
substitution.answer: He was born in May.

substitution.prompt: I work ___ night. (at / on / in)
substitution.answer: I work at night.

translate.en: I get up at seven in the morning.
She doesn't work on Saturday.
What time is it now?
The day after tomorrow is Tuesday.

fix.wrong: I get up in seven o'clock.
fix.right: I get up at seven o'clock.

lessons.tip: Uchta istisnoni yodlab oling: at night, in the morning / afternoon / evening, on Monday morning (kun + kunning qismi birga kelsa — on).
